lines: raw-native 0.6.0 renders a scene, and then it checks its own lighting.
Ambient occlusion darkens the places light has trouble reaching: creases, corners and the ground under an object.
The reference traces 64 rays from every pixel. It is slow, and it is the standard to meet.
The fast method estimates the same thing from the depth buffer, with 24 samples a pixel.
raw-native compares the two over 37,996 pixels. The error is 0.129, against a tolerance of 0.12.
So the certificate says refuted: on this scene, the fast method is not close enough.
The certificate is a file. Anyone can run the render again and check the same numbers.
